Originally released in 1998 "First Floor” is Detroit/Chicago auteur Theo Parrish’s debut album. Released on vinyl in two parts for maximum playability; the raw bluesy, soulful offbeat grooves have long since buried themselves deep under the skin of the house community.Showcasing Theo’s innovative use of drum programming and effects its uniquely loose but taut knit of minimalist elements worked to maximal, hypnotic effect have solidified its reputation as a contemporary classic and served as a corner stone for Theo’s truly legendary status."First Floor” is one of those albums that has transcended generic borders to influence heads of all stripes with its unmistakable soul-nuzzling texture and groove. Essential.

item.title: Los Hermanos - Keep Hold Tight EP
item.description: Label: Rawax Germany | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: Disco House , Detroit House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Rawax Germany

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: Disco House , Detroit House

Gerald Mitchell - the Detroit keyboardist and producer perhaps best known by his UR aliases Hardlife, 044 and The Deacon - revives his less celebrated but equally power-packed Los Hermanos project for 'Keep Hold Tight', the fourth release in the Motor City Edition series with Rawax. Title urger 'Keep Hold Tight' brings snippeted radio funk and a glistening down-coat of neon pads - holding us in tight-roped suspense - while 'Hey You' flips into a more morphotic beatjazz groove, though not without a reliable four-kick-drive foundation. 'Lifted Soul' and 'The Descendant' further minimalise the B-side in adroit Detroit manner.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Keep Hold Tight

  • B1. Lifted Soul

item.title: Fresh & Low - Love Capsule Deluxe (reissue)
item.description: Label: Rawax Germany | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: House , Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Rawax Germany

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: House , Classic House

For the latest missive on their occasional 'Treasures' series of hand-picked reissues, Rawax takes us back to 1998 and one of the loveliest moments from UK deep house stalwarts Fresh & Low - then a collaboration between Callum Walker, David Robertson and Julian Dambinski. What we get is the four most essential versions of 'Love Capsule Deluxe', starting with the original vocal take - a gorgeously immersive, loved-up and quietly soulful slab of wide-eyed, early morning deep house haziness topped off with a superbly seductive lead vocal. We're then treated to the bumpin', Rhodes-and-synth-sax rich 'Sax In Space Dub', the ultra-deep, San Francisco style headiness of the brilliant 'Deep Space Dub', and a second vocal mix with a breezier and more intergalactic-sounding flex. A genuine UK deep house classic - don't sleep!

Tracklist:

  • A1. Love Capsule Deluxe
  • A2. Love Capsule Deluxe
  • B1. Love Capsule Deluxe (Sax In Space dub)
  • B2. Love Capsule Deluxe (vocal mix Two)

item.title: The Coastal Commision Feat Cpen - Rhodes Through Space
item.description: Label: Pacific Coast House | Prix: 22,00 € | Style: House , Tech House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Pacific Coast House

Prix: 22,00 €

Style: House , Tech House

For a brief period between 1999 and 2003, Los Angeles label Pacific Coast House Recordings released a swathe of heady, sun-soaked EPs that frequently blurred the boundaries between tech-house and deep house. The man behind the imprint was Sam Robson AKA The Coastal Commission, who started the story with the original version of this sought-after EP. Now reissued on orange vinyl (a nod to the look of the original pressing), it remains a true West Coast house gem. For proof, check out the awesome 'Rhodes in Space', where drifting, ambient style chords, spacey electronics and dubbed-out synth motifs ride a chunky bassline and smooth, tech-tinged deep house drums. Flip-side 'Straight No Chaser' explores similar sonic territory, offering food for the head, heart and feet via locked-in grooves and irresistibly immersive sound design.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Rhodes Through Space
  • B1. Straight No Chaser

item.title: Niccolo Turini - Cutting Sound
item.description: Label: 4lux | Prix: 18,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: 4lux

Prix: 18,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Some classically timeless, retro-futurist deep house warmth here, as Pisa producer Niccolo Turini makes his bow on Gert-Jan Bijl aka Gerd's long-running 4 Lux label. Rich in classic drum and synth-sounds, much of the material is propulsive and energetic enough for peak-time floors, but thanks to its atmospheric sonics and huggable motifs could also be played in warm-up or after-hours sets. Highlights include Mr Fingers-influenced early morning deep house jazziness of 'Let The Music Bring You Up', the chunky and wide-eyed 'Take Me To The Moon', the weighty deep-and-jacking headiness of 'People From My Loves' and the simply gorgeous 'Get Down'

item.title: Rick Wade - Players Theme [repress]
item.description: Label: Robsoul | Prix: 13,00 € | Style: Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Robsoul

Prix: 13,00 €

Style: Classic House

Following the recent dip into the Theo Parrish archives that was The Twin Cities, Phil Weeks' Robsoul imprint looks to another one of Detroit's adopted sons in the form of Rick Wade. Like that recent Parrish reissue, Weeks re-releases another three tracks from Wade's bulging discography. The upbeat disco loops of "Players Theme" was originally released on French label Funky Chocolate in 2002 and still sound fresher than anything being plied by the Soundcloud dwellers today, while "Can't You See" from 2003 provides a more soulful take on house music. On the flip, the tracky funk and cascading string melodies of "I Feel Good" originally graced Wade's own Harmonie Park imprint in 1998, but sound no less vital today. Essential.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Players Theme
  • A2. Can't You See
  • B1.I Feel Good
